verdict.rationale: GoDaddy documents first-party natural-language paths: a gddy agent skill that lets a user ask an AI agent in plain language to find, price, register, or update DNS by running real gddy commands. It also offers an official MCP server for conversational domain search, and NL queries in its domain search API. The language understanding comes from an external AI agent rather than a native NL interface, and the MCP server covers only search and availability, so coverage of operating the whole product is limited. missing for 10: native first-party natural-language interface not dependent on a third-party agent, NL coverage beyond domains (e.g., Commerce APIs) and beyond search in the MCP server, independent or hands-on corroboration that NL operation works reliably.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: you can ask your agent to find a domain, check pricing, register it, or update DNS records in plain language, and it runs the actual `gddy` commands using your own authenticated session.
The gddy agent skill helps an AI coding agent install and use the gddy CLI on your behalf.
The GoDaddy MCP server lets AI assistants search for domain names and check domain availability directly from a conversation
discover alternative names based on keywords or natural-language queries
